1. **File: `drivers/infiniband/hw/mlx5/main.c`**
   - A new line of code was added to handle the case where the creation of a unicast flow rule fails. Specifically, if `create_leftovers_rule` returns an error (indicated by `IS_ERR(handler_ucast)`), the patch introduces a call to `mlx5_del_flow_rule(handler->rule);` to delete the previously created multicast flow rule. This prevents a resource leak by ensuring that the multicast flow rule is properly cleaned up when the unicast rule cannot be added.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `main.c` addresses a specific bug related to resource management in the flow steering implementation. The addition of the line to delete the multicast flow rule is directly related to the failure of adding a unicast rule. This change ensures that resources are not leaked when an error occurs during the flow rule creation process, thereby improving the robustness of the flow steering functionality in the mlx5 driver. The fix is a corrective measure for the previously introduced flow steering support, as indicated by the reference to the commit that introduced the bug.

You will be given the root cause of a bug, the commit message and the corresponding patch.
        You need to extract all code statements that lead to the bug from the patch, based on the root cause and the commit message.

        Root cause:
        The bug is caused by a failure to properly manage resources when adding a unicast flow rule. If the creation of the unicast rule fails, the previously allocated multicast flow rule is not deleted, leading to a resource leak. This occurs because the error handling did not include a cleanup step for the multicast rule, which should have been executed to prevent the leak.
        
        Commit message:
        IB/mlx5: Fix steering resource leak

Fix multicast flow rule leak on adding unicast rule failure.

Fixes: 038d2ef87572 ('IB/mlx5: Add flow steering support')
Signed-off-by: Maor Gottlieb <maorg@mellanox.com>
Signed-off-by: Leon Romanovsky <leon@kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Doug Ledford <dledford@redhat.com>  
        
        Patch:
        diff --git a/drivers/infiniband/hw/mlx5/main.c b/drivers/infiniband/hw/mlx5/main.c
index 840fbd0c9dca..87988fbc87b4 100644
--- a/drivers/infiniband/hw/mlx5/main.c
+++ b/drivers/infiniband/hw/mlx5/main.c
@@ -1861,6 +1861,7 @@ static struct mlx5_ib_flow_handler *create_leftovers_rule(struct mlx5_ib_dev *de
 						 &leftovers_specs[LEFTOVERS_UC].flow_attr,
 						 dst);
 		if (IS_ERR(handler_ucast)) {
+			mlx5_del_flow_rule(handler->rule);
 			kfree(handler);
 			handler = handler_ucast;
 		} else {
